TASK-008.title: Rebalance domain and application source ownership
TASK-008.summary: Move pure CodeWiki concepts, types, value rules, and invariants from application shims into focused domain modules while keeping application code as workflow/use-case orchestration.

goal.outcome: The package source reflects the documented domain-led architecture: core concepts live under src/domain, application modules consume them, and behavior stays unchanged.
acceptance: Domain-specific type/value definitions are organized under src/domain/<concept> instead of one broad shared shim where practical.
Application modules import concept types/rules from domain modules and retain use-case/orchestration, file I/O, graph rebuild, gateway, tool, and local runtime logic.
No adapter/UI/Node I/O dependencies are introduced into src/domain/**.
Existing public tool behavior and generated artifact shapes remain compatible.
non_goals: Do not redesign product behavior, CodeWiki artifact schemas, or public tool contracts.
Do not introduce a top-level infrastructure layer.
Do not rewrite unrelated application workflows beyond moving pure domain concepts/rules.
verification: targeted architecture/import checks for domain dependency direction
relevant smoke tests if the baseline runner can execute

delta.desired: Domain concepts define CodeWiki language and invariants; application modules orchestrate workflows over those concepts.
delta.current: Many pure concepts and schema/value definitions are concentrated in src/domain/shared/types.ts and application modules, making domain look like a shim.
delta.closure: Typecheck and architecture checks pass or any pre-existing runner failure is documented with scope.

SPRINT-001.title: CodeWiki vNext decision and graph workflow
SPRINT-001.outcome: Deliver the vNext operating model in bounded compatibility-safe increments, now prioritizing agent-owned session-boundary automation and workflow-efficiency friction reduction before decision_build implementation.
gates: Prioritize TASK-005 session-boundary automation/workflow-friction work before TASK-001 decision_build implementation until this accepted priority is resolved.
Keep current CodeWiki public behavior frozen except critical blocker fixes until vNext replacement flows validate.
Do not remove compatibility feedback/documentation/build/tool primitives before deprecation tests pass.
Each task must produce implementation_build and fresh validation evidence before close.
